summary: Implement reusable measurement covariance, acceptance, predictive support, normal-herald and Hermitian-completion contracts with a strict offline interface and native score primitive.
scope: Close the reusable software gaps identified in the algebra/device synthesis without duplicating existing QET, passivity, identifiability, archived atlas certificates, or the independent hardware-residuals analysis. Completion covers implementation and local validation, not provider acquisition, physical discoveries, hosted review, or merge.

reconciliation.note: The source audit distinguishes existing implementations and archived certificates from the missing reusable APIs. Analytic fixtures carry explicit observation laws and never enter the measured research ledger.

resolution: The bounded implementation provides three Python modules, five offline analysis kinds, full native score covariance, 164 new Python tests, 25 existing counter regressions, 13 Rust tests, and passing scoped lint/type checks. Physical data collection and repository review remain separate obligations. The macOS BLAS overflow exception mismatch receives an explicit finite check and a deterministic silent-overflow regression.

steps.action: Implement full vector-score covariance, joint predictive covariance and residual-support admission.
steps.acceptance: Independent covariance oracles, zero-score populations, shared-data cross terms, impossible joint covariance and numerical boundary regressions pass.

receipts.result: Reusable observation-law contracts and deterministic analytic fixtures; no provider acquisition or physical-origin inference. Local checks pass as recorded in validation.json.

The portability correction passes 164 new Python tests and pinned style/type checks. Existing counter regressions remain retained at their observed revision; full native hosted CI passes. As of revision 32c8feec6e5eddf3b73e2b0b4411d3e787606e78, Python hosted revalidation remains pending.

First-pass review fixes: the predictive-residual covariance is admitted to the roundoff bound of its congruence, the tomography completion refuses an allocation above its entry budget, the row sums reach the process pool only above a size threshold, the analytic result replays byte for byte under the on-demand gate core-measurement-observability, and 198 Python tests (164 before) pass with pinned Ruff and mypy. The observation is of the uncommitted tree on top of the revision named here. Hosted revalidation of the resulting head is not observed.

Second-pass review fixes: real arrays and Hermitian expectations are admitted by scalar type before promotion, score rows whose products overflow are summed under one exact power-of-two scale, the exact weighted mean and the offset sum come from one pooled row worker, the covariance score standardizes under a common power of two, and the strict JSON reader rejects a literal that underflows to zero. Observed commands: ci/pr_checks.sh lint, types and tests on the four measurement test files (226 passed), pytest of the same four files (226 passed), ci/pr_checks.sh gates --gates core-measurement-observability (pass after the analytic result was regenerated with its gate command; only the three producer digests changed). The observation is of the working tree on top of revision 114e61ddc5e3c616df978f9842ac45090aacdff7. Hosted revalidation of the resulting head is not observed.
